artworks.title: The Betrothal of the Holy Virgin
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (upper corners rounded): 24.7 x 20.5 cm (9 3/4 x 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body depiction of three figures positioned in a scene of interaction. The central figure stands upright, facing the viewer, wearing a tall hat and a long robe. On either side, two other figures lean slightly toward the central figure. The figure on the left has long hair and a beard, draped in a robe, while the figure on the right also wears a robe and a head covering. All three are engaged in a gesture of joining hands, with the central figure's hands extended toward the hands of the others. There is no noticeable detail of facial features due to the style of the sketch, which is simple and linear. The background consists of a curtained setting with hints of arches and pillars, suggesting an indoor setting. The image is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Mother and Child
artworks.medium: reed pen and brown ink
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch of a seated woman holding a child in her arms. The woman is on the right, sitting with her body facing the left. Her knees are bent, and her arms cradle the child. She is wearing a flowing cloak that covers most of her body, and a cloth covering on her head. Her facial features are indistinct, but she looks downward at the child. The child is also wrapped in cloth, but one of their arms is visible, their hand by their mouth. The background is blank. The lines of the drawing are dark brown against beige paper.

artworks.title: An Oriental
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brush and brown-black ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 12.8 x 7.3 cm (5 1/16 x 2 7/8 in.)
support: 20.3 x 14.9 cm (8 x 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch of a man standing and facing slightly to the right, his face in profile. He has a long, straight nose, a full, dark beard, and a dark mustache. He is wearing a high hat with a tall brim. His clothing consists of a flowing outer garment like a thick cloak that covers most of his body. A sash or belt is visible around his waist, tying a tunic-like garment. The lines of the drawing are loose, and the background is beige paper.

artworks.title: Saskia
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman's upper body, including her head, shoulders, and part of her arms. She is facing slightly to the right, with her head turned slightly to the left. Her facial features are delicately sketched, with her eyes gazing to the side, a slightly pronounced nose, and moderately full lips with a subtle expression. Her hair is curly and flows around her shoulders, with a hint of an adornment woven into it. She is wearing a garment with visible buttons on the bodice, and there is a necklace around her neck. The surrounding area blends into a neutral background with no distinct landscape or objects, keeping the focus on her. The drawing is warm-toned, likely achieved with reddish or sepia chalk.

artworks.title: Temptation of Christ
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two people interacting with each other. The person on the left is in profile, extending their arms out towards the person on the right. They appear to have the legs and tail of a goat, and they wear a pointed hat that flops forward. They hold something in their outstretched hands which looks like a bowl. The person on the right is a man with long hair and a beard. He wears long, draped robes. His body is turned to the right, but he looks over his shoulder at the object held out to him by the other person, lifting one of his hands slightly. The scene is set against a backdrop of minimalistic landscape features with simple lines defining the ground and a few indications of natural forms, such as rocks or a bank. The drawing is executed with dark, fluid lines and has a sketch-like quality. The background is beige paper.

artworks.title: An Old Scholar at His Desk
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an individual in a hunched position leaning forward. The person's upper torso is visible, with their arms resting on a surface. The person has defined facial features, including heavy lines, a short beard or facial hair, and is wearing a cap or headscarf. The person's attire appears to be loose robes or fabric around their shoulders and arms. They are interacting with scroll-like objects, one of which is on the table. The background is a simple, textured wash of brown, with no concrete details.

artworks.title: Bust of an Elderly Man in a Flat Cap
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing is a sketch of an elderly man from the chest up, shown in profile, facing the right. He has deep-set eyes, a small nose, thin, downturned lips, and a soft chin covered by curved lines suggesting a beard. He wears a large wide-brimmed hat that casts a dark shadow on his face, as well as a loose garment over his shoulders and chest. His left arm is held up to his chest and appears to have cloth draped over it. The background is plain, and the drawing is executed with dark lines on textured beige paper.

artworks.title: Sketches from a Tavern: Woman Standing and Two Men Seated
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals from the waist up in a sketch. One person on the left stands in the background, while the central figure is seated or leaning forward. Another individual seated on the right holds a cylindrical object. The background is simple, with hatched lines for depth or texture.

artworks.title: Le mari confident
artworks.medium: pen and india ink

artworks.title: Second Day, Second Story: Rinaldo d'Asti and the Widow
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with brown wash over traces of red chalk on laid paper, laid down
artworks.dimensions: overall (to outer framing line): 11.3 x 5.7 cm (4 7/16 x 2 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing shows three people in a well-furnished room. On the left is a seated woman in an elegant gown with a fan, sitting near a fireplace on the far left, her body turned to face us. She has a necklace and earrings, and her hair is up in a bun. Behind her is a standing woman in a long dress with a bonnet who holds the arm of a standing man in loose-fitting attire. The man has long hair and is barefoot. All three people have light skin. The room is ornately decorated with floral designs on the wall, a cabinet of plates and dishes, a block on the walls, and a candelabra on the mantle above the fireplace. The floor is covered by a rug with swirling patterns. Beneath the print is a line of text.

artworks.title: Second Day, Seventh Story: The Duke of Athens Contemplating the Sleeping Princess Alatiel
artworks.artist: Hubert François Gravelot after François Boucher
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash over traces of red chalk on laid paper, laid down
artworks.dimensions: overall (to the outer framing line): 11.2 x 5.8 cm (4 7/16 x 2 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring two figures. One figure is elaborately dressed and standing, holding a container, while the other is reclining beneath a canopy. The setting includes columns, drapery, and another figure in the background. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and contrasting elements.

artworks.title: Eighth Day, First Story, Madonna Ambruogia Gives Her Husband the Two Hundred Florins She Was Given by Gulfardo in Payment for Her Favors
artworks.medium: graphite on wove(?) paper with a border line in pen and brown ink, laid down
artworks.dimensions: overall (to the outer framing line): 11 x 5.5 cm (4 5/16 x 2 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing with three people, two standing and one sitting. On the left is a woman standing with her body turned slightly to the left and her head pointed towards the right, looking over her shoulder. She wears a long dress with puffed sleeves and has her hair in an updo. One of her hands is clasped in a fist, and the other holds a small pouch. In the center stands a man facing the left, looking towards the woman. He is reaching toward the pouch she holds, with his mouth set in a smile. He wears a suit and a bow tie, and his hair is tied back, with one curl by his ear. On the right, in front of the other two people, the third person is seated at a table, writing in a large book with a feather quill. The room they are in is elaborately decorated, with several framed objects hanging on the walls and an open doorway in the center leading to another room. The drawing is surrounded by several borders of varying thicknesses in shades of brown, black, cream, and pale green.

artworks.title: Tenth Day, Ninth Story: Saladin Bestows Rich Gifts on the Sleeping Torello
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash over touches of red chalk on laid paper, laid down
artworks.dimensions: overall (to outer framing line): 11.3 x 5.7 cm (4 7/16 x 2 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals gathered around a central seated figure. The scene takes place in an opulent, classical architectural setting, featuring ornate columns and detailed ceiling decorations. The central figure is reclining on a lavishly decorated couch, adorned with intricately patterned fabrics and surrounded by various vessels and trays. The other figures, clad in elaborate flowing robes and headdresses, are engaged in interactions with the central figure. This image exudes a sense of theatricality and dramatic interaction, suggestive of a narrative moment captured in the drawing. The style suggests a historical or allegorical theme, and the composition is characterized by precise line work and a harmonious blend of sepia tones.

artworks.title: Nine Children Listening to a Girl Tell a Story; A Boy Handing a Purse to a Girl Seated on a Bed
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with brown wash on laid paper, laid down
artworks.dimensions: overall (to outer framing line): 14.3 x 8.1 cm (5 5/8 x 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: Two illustrations are shown in the image. The upper one features a person seated on a rock ledge surrounded by other figures. The lower section portrays two cherubic figures on a bed within a decorative frame. The upper illustration is attributed to H. Gravelot.

artworks.title: The Great Flood
artworks.medium: graphite on vellum
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic deluge scene. The scene depicts a flood where figures appear to be struggling amidst a torrential downpour. A tumultuous sea or river overwhelms the landscape, with many bodies seemingly battling the elements, climbing and clinging to rocks, and some attempting to reach higher ground. The craggy outcrops and the swirling waters add to the drama and desperation of the scene. The sky above is filled with thick, dark clouds. The drawing is framed in an ornate border.

artworks.title: Jupiter couvre la Terre de Nuages pour jouir d'Io
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and brush and brown ink with brown wash over graphite

artworks.title: Phaeton au Palais du Soleil ...
artworks.medium: graphite
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with various figures in a classical setting. The scene features an interior with columns, a central figure on a throne surrounded by light rays, and another figure approaching with an outstretched arm. Several other figures are seated on clouds or perches around them. The drawing is bordered by an ornate frame and includes scripted text in French at the bottom.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Callisto
artworks.medium: graphite on wove(?) paper, laid down
artworks.description: The artwork features a detailed illustration of multiple figures in a natural setting. The central scene shows three figures seated among foliage. A female figure in the center is reclined against another figure, with her face turned towards her companions. Two female figures are engaged in conversation, while a cherubic child reaches towards them. Above, a floating figure is surrounded by clouds and tree branches. In the foreground, hunting dogs rest beside a horn. The background includes trees and clouds, creating a pastoral setting. The illustration is framed with an ornate border and attributed to Ch. Eisen from 1765, depicting the mythological theme of Jupiter taking the form of Diana to seduce the nymph Callisto.

artworks.title: Perseus Turning Phinneas to Stone with the Head of Medusa
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown and gray wash over traces of graphite, with double border line by the artist in pen and gray ink, on laid paper, laid down
artworks.dimensions: image (to outer framing line): 13.4 x 9.1 cm (5 1/4 x 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting Perseus holding up the severed head of Medusa. Another figure, possibly Athena, hovers above with a spear and shield. Onlookers, likely soldiers or warriors, react to Medusa's head. The background features clouds and distant lands. The figures are detailed and wear intricate clothing and armor. The border of the drawing is ornate with decorative elements.

artworks.title: Aurora and Cephalus
artworks.medium: brown chalk with stumping on light beige laid paper, with later framing line in brown ink

artworks.title: La Famine par l'ordre de Ceres ...
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and brush and black ink with gray wash
artworks.description: The image shows two figures: one lying in bed and the other hovering above. The figure in bed is depicted from the waist up, lying on their back with eyes closed and a serene expression. Their hair is short, and their facial features are relaxed. The hovering figure is shown in semi-profile, with elongated limbs and a dramatic pose reaching towards the person in bed. This figure has long hair and aged features, adding a sense of movement against the stillness below. The bed is draped with flowing bedclothes, and a lit oil lamp sits on a small table beside the bed. The background features billowing clouds, framed by curtains, creating a dream-like setting. The scene is enclosed within an ornate border with floral motifs and text.

artworks.title: La Famine par l'ordre de Cérès vient répandre son venin sur Eresicthon, tandis qu'il dormoit
artworks.medium: etching and engraving with stipple
artworks.description: This is an illustration showing a spectral figure hovering over a person in bed. The bed is detailed with fabric drapery, and a table with a lit candle is nearby. The setting is dark with a mysterious atmosphere, and the room is shaded with clouds. The illustration is framed by decorative flowers and ribbons.

artworks.title: Venus appuyee sur son cher Adonis ...
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on faded blue laid paper

artworks.title: The Sacrifice of Iphigenia
artworks.medium: pen and brush and black ink with gray wash over traces of graphite with border line by the artist on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of several characters within a scene featuring clouds and classical architecture. The central figure is reclining, surrounded by other figures displaying various emotions and interactions. A winged figure is above, reaching towards the group, accompanied by a ram-like animal. The composition is filled with drapery, gestures, and expressions, creating a dense atmosphere full of narrative and historical elements.
